Monsieur mon R.P. de A Aix ce 2 Juin 1637. Vostre tres-humble & tres obeissant Ser-viteur. De P EYRES C.
main_text.head: EPIST. LI.
J. Morinus Petro à Valle. De Codici-bus MSS. Samaritanorum, vari-isque inter se collationibus non-nulla.
main_text.p: Perillustri D. D. Petro à Valle Joannes Morinus S.P.D.

Suspicari non abs re potuisti, perillustris Domine, me tui beneficii, quod à te accepi, immemorem esse, cùm jam annus alter effluxerit, aut etiam amplius, ex quo de me deque tuo Manuscripto Samaritano nihil prorsus acceperis, aut e-tiam forte audieris. Rescripsera abhinc tres menses R. Patri Goezaldo, ut te meo

page.notes: The initial S of "Suspicari" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. The page number and the gathering signature are faint and uncertain. "Rescripsera" and "Goezaldo" are read from the scan and may be misprinted or misread; the signature "S 5" is uncertain. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.
